plan.title: BOQ Templates Absent from eRFX Picker

steps.note: Open the ordinary eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the required project title so the create flow is valid.
Configure the ordinary eRFX project with an RFQ pricing stage.
Open the RFQ pricing-stage template picker and assert that at least one template is offered while BOQ-labelled templates are absent.
